selection_rule: Train = 16 tasks with vanilla llm_agent baseline pass<=1/8 (k=8, merged 20260628-29 runs) AND champion full_v31 pass>=3/4, i.e. hardest-for-bare tasks with proven memory-fixability. Dev = 6 anchors with vanilla 8/8 (10/12/25 are champion-regression-prone sentinels, 17/24/47 stable) + 6 improvable tasks with vanilla 1-2/8 and champion>=3/4. Wall-suspect tasks (both vanilla<=2/8 and champion<=1/4: 41,76,82,105,20,64,93,32,38) are excluded from train and dev. All remaining 86 tasks are frozen; no test id is read during the run.

fixed_budget.stop_rule: Complete every scheduled train trial; run the paired repair screen before spending the held-out dev gate.

note: From-zero observation run: deterministic neutral M0, autonomous arm, no champion or historical package content enters the loop. Champion per-task map is used only offline for task selection and post-hoc scoring.
